**The first — and final — release of the piecewise constant series for the BIRT chart engine.**

`io.github.lextpf.birt.chart.piecewiseconstant` adds a `PiecewiseConstantSeries` that *holds* each
value until the step to the next data point: a step line, a staircase, a zero-order hold. It
subclasses BIRT's `LineSeries`, so markers, labels, stacking, transposed charts and the legend all
keep working. Step modes `After` (the default), `Before` and `Center`. No UI code, no configuration,
no registration call — the plug-in registers itself through three extension points.

### 📦 Assets

- 🧩 **`io.github.lextpf.birt.chart.piecewiseconstant_1.0.0.jar`** — *take this one.* The OSGi bundle, with `plugin.xml` and `META-INF/MANIFEST.MF` at its root.
- 📖 `io.github.lextpf.birt.chart.piecewiseconstant_1.0.0-sources.jar` — the sources, for reading.
- 🔐 `SHA256SUMS` — SHA-256 over both jars.

### 🗂️ Where the jar goes

- 🖥️ POJO runtime — the `birt-runtime` distribution, `ReportRunner`, a servlet with the engine on its classpath → `ReportEngine/lib/`, or any other classpath entry
- 🌐 BIRT Viewer, `birt.war` → `WEB-INF/lib/`
- 🧱 OSGi runtime, or anything that sets `BIRT_HOME` → `<BIRT_HOME>/platform/plugins/`
- 🎨 Eclipse BIRT Designer → `<eclipse>/dropins/plugins/`, then restart with `-clean`

### ✅ Compatibility

Java 21 (`Bundle-RequiredExecutionEnvironment: JavaSE-21`), BIRT 4.24 up to but not including 5.0
(`Require-Bundle: org.eclipse.birt.chart.engine;bundle-version="[4.24.0,5.0.0)"`). Built against
BIRT 4.24.0. On a POJO classpath there is no version check.

### ⚠️ Why this is the last one

The step line belongs *inside* BIRT, not beside it. It is proposed upstream as a first-class
`LineSeries.interpolation` attribute in [eclipse-birt#2480](https://github.com/eclipse-birt/birt/pull/2480)
(fixes [#2478](https://github.com/eclipse-birt/birt/issues/2478)). Once that merges, this plug-in is
deprecated and there will be no v1.1. The jar keeps working either way: it is self-contained and
needs nothing at runtime that BIRT does not already ship.
